polls.description: Escalating tensions between US and China over AI technology with China blocking Meta deals, US banning chip sales, and companies scrambling for alternatives.
polls.question: Are these tech export controls necessary security measures or economic warfare?

cluster_stories.title: China’s Meta Backlash Renders Manus Model ‘Officially Dead’
cluster_stories.summary: The AI startup Manus, once hailed as a breakthrough that would challenge Silicon Valley’s dominance, is turning into a cautionary tale for Chinese entrepreneurs after Beijing authorities ordered Meta Platforms Inc. to unwind its $2 billion takeover of the company.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA KILLS MANUS AI STARTUP... META BACKLASH INTENSIFIES

cluster_stories.title: China threatens the EU with broad retaliation if Huawei and ZTE are banned from European networks
cluster_stories.summary: Beijing’s commerce ministry has formally submitted a 30-page document warning the European Commission that its draft Cybersecurity Act, which would make vendor removal mandatory for the first time, could trigger reciprocal measures against European companies in China. China has formally threatened the European Union with retaliation if a sweeping new cybersecurity law leads to the […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA THREATENS EU Over Huawei/ZTE Ban

cluster_stories.title: Meta to backtrack acquisition of AI firm Manus after China block: report
cluster_stories.summary: Meta is reportedly reversing its acquisition of AI startup Manus. China has banned the deal, citing national security. The AI agent was founded in China but is now based in Singapore. Meta stated the transaction complied with law. Analysts had warned of regulatory issues amid US-China tech rivalry.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS Meta AI Acquisition... Security Concerns

cluster_stories.title: China blocks Zuck’s acquisition of AI outfit Manus
cluster_stories.summary: Back to the drawing board for Meta's AI ambitions China has blocked Meta’s acquisition of AI upstart Manus.…
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS ZUCK'S AI ACQUISITION... META DEAL DEAD

cluster_stories.title: Huawei’s AI chip sales surge as Nvidia stalls in China
cluster_stories.summary: Chinese tech companies place large orders for the Shenzhen-based group’s latest range of AI processors
cluster_stories.headline: HUAWEI AI Chip Sales SURGE as Nvidia Blocked in China

cluster_stories.title: US orders chip equipment companies to halt some shipments to China's No. 2 chipmaker Hua Hong
cluster_stories.summary: America has moved to curb China's chip ambitions. The US Commerce Department has directed chip equipment companies to stop sending tools to Hua Hong. This action targets facilities believed to be producing China's most advanced chips. Top US suppliers are reportedly among those notified. The move aims to protect America's technological lead.
cluster_stories.headline: US BANS Chip Equipment Sales to China's Hua Hong

cluster_stories.title: Big Chinese tech firms scramble to secure Huawei AI chips after DeepSeek V4 launch
cluster_stories.summary: Amidst the growing competition in artificial intelligence, Chinese tech behemoths are racing to secure Huawei's Ascend 950 AI chips. The urgency follows the debut of DeepSeek's V4 AI model, designed to optimize Huawei's cutting-edge hardware. Giants like ByteDance, Tencent, and Alibaba are urgently sourcing new chip supplies, signaling a significant movement away from American semiconductor reliance.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINESE TECH GIANTS SCRAMBLE for Huawei AI Chips

cluster_stories.title: China’s Mao-era regulator in a stand-off with Meta over AI
cluster_stories.summary: National Development Reform Commission is becoming Beijing’s chief enforcer
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA'S MAO-ERA REGULATOR In Stand-Off With Meta Over AI

cluster_stories.title: Beijing’s blunt message to its tech sector
cluster_stories.summary: China’s ban on Meta-Manus deal is a warning to keep AI innovations at home
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS META Deal - Keeps AI Innovations at Home

cluster_stories.title: China’s decision to block the $2 billion Meta-Manus deal shows how far Washington and Beijing are drifting apart over AI
cluster_stories.summary: Both Washington and Beijing now seek to maintain control of strategic technologies and prevent them from leaking to the other.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS $2B Meta-Manus AI DEAL... US-China Tech War Escalates
